user.title: Set up historical load forecast
user.description: Use household total power (including EV charging) and the combined EV charging power sensor. Configure EVs afterward in Options.

data.live_decay_minutes: Legacy decay time constant (minutes; decay mode only)

data_description.live_correction_mode: Inertia learns sustained non-EV load deviations. Historical baseline only disables live correction. Legacy decay reacts immediately to each reading.
data_description.inertia_response_minutes: Inertia mode only. Larger values reject brief spikes more strongly but adapt more slowly. A two-stage smoother uses this time constant and a faster stage at one quarter of it.
data_description.inertia_horizon_hours: Inertia mode only. Apply the learned offset across the first two-thirds of this future window, then taper it to zero over the final third. The rest of the horizon stays historical.
data_description.inertia_deadband_kw: Inertia mode only. Ignore this amount of the learned offset in either direction; 0.1 kW means 100 W. The smooth deadband reduces chatter.
data_description.inertia_maximum_kw: Inertia mode only. Bound the positive or negative correction. Forecast power is never allowed below zero.
data_description.live_decay_minutes: Used only by Legacy instant correction with decay. It has no effect in Inertia mode, so it may remain 0.
